aarti.tek: Listen, my Goddess who dwells on the mountain:
no one has found your limit.
aarti.pad1: Betel leaf, areca nut, a flag and a coconut
have been brought and offered to you.
aarti.pad2: A red bodice graces your body,
and a saffron tilaka has been applied.
aarti.pad3: A temple was built for you on the high mountains,
and a town was founded below.
Your reign has stood through the Satya, Tretā and Dvāpara ages,
and in the Kali age it is greater by a quarter.
aarti.pad4: Incense, a lamp, food offerings, the āratī
and mohanbhog, a sweet, have been offered.
The devotee Dhyānū sings the Mother's praises;
he has gained the fruit his heart desired.
